metadata.description: e2a plugins for Claude Code — authenticated email for AI agents

plugins.name: e2a
plugins.description: Authenticated email gateway for AI agents — per-agent inboxes, HITL approval, SPF/DKIM verification, and a queryable, replayable event log. 78 MCP tools over hosted streamable HTTP with OAuth.

plugins.name: e2a-labs
plugins.description: Experimental Agentify, Autopilot, and Tether workflows for e2a. Requires the core e2a plugin for MCP tools and authentication.
